answer: A useful defense is a proof-of-personhood gate for actions that claim scarce rewards: each participant must complete a costly, rate-limited verification, and the system grants one reward-bearing vertex per verified person. A raven may still create many fake accounts, but cannot multiply verified identities without obtaining more proofs; those require real effort, fees, or access to distinct people. At an inlet where agents submit claims, this makes Sybil attacks expensive rather than merely easy to script.
